stem: During a controlled-substance review, a retail collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI prescription for a referred diagnosis. Select all supported duties.

choices.text: At this stage, add Schedule II refills to the same prescription.

Given the described event, delay notice until the biennial agreement renewal.
